about_the_game:
Music from the [W]orld of NieR that is sure to stir the so[U]l

This music album features the in-game BGM from the action RPG NieR:Automata.

Composed by Keiichi Okabe and the renowned music production studio MONACA, known for their work on NieR Replicant and NieR Gestalt, the album delivers an extensive collection of tracks that enhance the game’s immersive experience.

Dive into the captivating and emotional world of NieR’s music—an unforgettable journey awaits.
